cards.back: A solid shape with 6 square faces. A dice is a cube. It cannot roll.
cards.say: Cube. A solid shape with six square faces. A dice is a cube. It cannot roll.

figure.alt: A cube with six square faces.

cards.back: A solid shape with 6 flat faces that are rectangles. A shoe box is a cuboid.
cards.say: Cuboid. A solid shape with six flat faces that are rectangles. A shoe box is a cuboid.

cards.back: A round solid shape like a ball. It can roll in any direction.
cards.say: Sphere. A round solid shape like a ball. It can roll in any direction.

cards.back: A solid shape with 2 flat circle faces and 1 curved face. A tin can is a cylinder.
cards.say: Cylinder. A solid shape with two flat circle faces and one curved face. A tin can is a cylinder.

figure.alt: A cylinder like a tin can.

cards.back: A solid shape with 1 flat circle face, 1 curved face and 1 point. An ice cream cone is a cone.
cards.say: Cone. A solid shape with one flat circle face, one curved face and one point. An ice cream cone is a cone.

figure.alt: A cone with a circle base and a point.

cards.back: A solid shape with a flat base and sloping triangle faces that meet at a point.
cards.say: Pyramid. A solid shape with a flat base and sloping triangle faces that meet at a point.

cards.back: A flat surface on a solid shape.
cards.say: What is a face? A flat surface on a solid shape.

cards.back: Where two faces of a solid shape meet.

cards.front: How many faces does a cube have?
cards.back: 6 faces. All of them are squares.
cards.say: How many faces does a cube have? Six faces. All of them are squares.

cards.front: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
cards.back: 2 flat faces, the circles at the top and bottom.
cards.say: How many flat faces does a cylinder have? Two flat faces, the circles at the top and bottom.

cards.front: Which solid shape can roll in every direction?
cards.back: A sphere.
cards.say: Which solid shape can roll in every direction? A sphere.

cards.back: No. It has flat faces and sharp edges, so it stays still.
cards.say: Can a cube roll? No. It has flat faces and sharp edges, so it stays still.

cards.back: Yes, on its curved face. It cannot roll if it stands on a flat circle.
cards.say: Can a cylinder roll? Yes, on its curved face. It cannot roll if it stands on a flat circle.

cards.front: Which solid shape is a football?
cards.back: A sphere.
cards.say: Which solid shape is a football? A sphere.

cards.front: Which solid shape is a dice?
cards.back: A cube.
cards.say: Which solid shape is a dice? A cube.

cards.front: Which solid shape is a party hat?
cards.back: A cone.
cards.say: Which solid shape is a party hat? A cone.

cards.front: Which solid shape is a tin of beans?
cards.back: A cylinder.
cards.say: Which solid shape is a tin of beans? A cylinder.

cards.front: Which solid shape is a tissue box?
cards.back: A cuboid.
cards.say: Which solid shape is a tissue box? A cuboid.

cards.back: Cubes, cuboids and cylinders. They have flat faces.
cards.say: Which solid shapes stack well? Cubes, cuboids and cylinders. They have flat faces.

cards.front: Why is a sphere hard to stack?
cards.back: It has no flat face, so the shape on top rolls off.
cards.say: Why is a sphere hard to stack? It has no flat face, so the shape on top rolls off.

cards.front: What flat shape is the face of a cube?
cards.back: A square.
cards.say: What flat shape is the face of a cube? A square.

cards.front: What flat shape is the flat face of a cone?
cards.back: A circle.
cards.say: What flat shape is the flat face of a cone? A circle.

cards.back: A 2D shape is flat, like a drawing. A 3D shape is solid, and you can hold it.
cards.say: What is the difference between two D and three D shapes? A two D shape is flat, like a drawing. A three D shape is solid, and you can hold it.
